title: साहित्यिक समाजशास्त्रीय अध्अययन पद्धति: सैद्धान्तिक परिचर्चा {Methodology of Literary Sociological Studies: A Theoretical Discussion}
nepali: यस लेखमा रचनाको समाजशास्त्रीय आयतन र समाजशास्त्रको वस्तुगत आयतन खोज्ने उद्देश्यले कृतिको वस्तुता र समाजशास्त्रको वस्तुताको समवेत र अलग सिंहावलोकन गरिएको छ । समाज र जीवनको विविधता नै साहित्यको कच्चा पदार्थ हो । व्यक्ति सामाजिक हुनको नाताले उसका स्रष्टा र द्रष्टा दुबै व्यक्तिtव पनि यसैबाट निर्माण हुन्छन् । स्रष्टाले  र्जना गरेको कृतिभित्र प्रत्यक्ष रूपमा समाजशास्त्र हुन्छ । जसरी तोरी प्रत्यक्ष हो तर तोरी तोरीमात्र होइन त्यसले आफूभरि तेल बोकेको हुन्छ जो पेलेपछिमात्र हामी पाउँछौँ यसै गरी यस लेखमा साहित्यमा सन्निहित समाजशास्त्रको खोज गर्ने विधि वा पद्धति प्रस्तुत छ । यसमा ऐतिहासिक, तुलनात्मक एवम् प्रकार्यात्मक पद्धतिको परिचय र चर्चा गरिएको छ । समाजशास्त्रीय अध्ययनका मापदण्ड र मूल्यहरूको चर्चा गर्ने सन्दर्भमा समाज, जीवन र मनोविज्ञान कृतिमा खोज्न सकिने र कृतिबाट फेरि समाजशास्त्र खोज्न सकिने सैद्धान्तिक धरातलको चर्चा गरिएको छ । रचनाकारले साहित्यका विभिन्न विधामा आफ्ना अनुभूतिको प्रकटीकरण गर्छ । यस सन्दर्भमा उसले आफू बाँचेको युग, भोगेको जीवन र उसका अनुभूति समाजका आर्थिक, सामाजिक, सांस्कृतिक, राजनीतिक, धार्मिक, यथार्थ र मनोविज्ञान उसका रचनामा सुषुप्त वा प्रकट रूपमा पनि रहन्छ । कृतिबाट समाजको यही अन्तर्सम्बन्धको खोजी नै साहित्यको समाजशास्त्र हो । अझ स्पष्ट शब्दमा भन्दा साहित्यिक कृतिभित्रबाट समाजशास्त्रको खोजी गर्नु नै साहित्यको समाजशास्त्र हो । साहित्यको  समाजशास्त्र खोज्ने क्रममा साहित्यभित्र रहेको प्रजाति, युग र पर्यावरण, संस्कृति, संरचना र भाषिक शृङ्खला, विश्वदृष्टि, स्रष्टा र द्रष्टाबीचको अनुभूतिको संरचना र भाषिक अवस्थाको खोज अनुसन्धान साहित्यमा गरिन्छ । यो खोज र अनुसन्धान नै साहित्यको समाजशास्त्रीय अध्ययन हो । साहित्यको समाजशास्त्रीय अध्ययनका लागि ऐतिहासिक, तुलनात्मक र प्रकार्यात्मक पद्धतिको प्रयोग मूलभूत रूपमा गर्न सकिन्छ । साहित्यको समाजशास्त्रीय अध्ययनका लागि ‘साहित्य समाजको ऐना हो’ भन्ने दपर्ण सिद्धान्त र ‘साहित्य समाजको समीक्षा हो’ भन्ने समीक्षा सिद्धान्तका पक्षपाती दुई शाखा छन् । यसका मूल अभियन्ता मेडम डे स्टेल, इपिली तेन, रबर्ट स्कार्पिट, लियो लावेन्थल, लुसिए गोल्डम्यान र रेमन्ड विलियम्स हुन् ।
american_english: In this article, with the objective of exploring the sociological dimension of literary work and the objective dimension of sociology, a combined and separate overview of the objectivity of the literary work and the objectivity of sociology has been carried out. The diversity of society and life is the raw material of literature. Inasmuch as an individual is a social being, both their creator and observer personalities are constructed from this as well. Sociology is directly present within the work created by the author. Just as mustard seed is tangible, yet mustard seed is not merely mustard seed, carrying oil throughout itself that we obtain only after pressing it, in the same way, this article presents the method or methodology for investigating the sociology inherent in literature. In this, an introduction to and discussion of historical, comparative, and functional methods are presented. In the context of discussing the standards and values of sociological study, the theoretical groundwork on how society, life, and psychology can be sought in a work and how sociology can, in turn, be sought from the work is discussed. The writer expresses their perceptions across various genres of literature. In this context, the era in which he lived, the life he experienced, and his perceptions of society's economic, social, cultural, political, and religious realities and psychology also reside in his works either latently or overtly. The investigation of this very interrelationship of society from the literary work is the sociology of literature. To state it in clearer terms, seeking sociology from within a literary work is itself the sociology of literature. In the course of seeking the sociology of literature, research and investigation are conducted in literature into race, era and milieu, culture, structure and linguistic sequence, world view, the structure of perception between creator and observer, and the linguistic condition. This inquiry and research is itself the sociological study of literature. For the sociological study of literature, historical, comparative, and functional methods can be fundamentally employed. For the sociological study of literature, there are two branches advocating the reflection theory that 'literature is a mirror of society' and the critique theory that 'literature is a critique of society.' Its principal proponents are Madame de Staël, Hippolyte Taine, Robert Escarpit, Leo Lowenthal, Lucien Goldmann, and Raymond Williams.

informal_english: In this paper, with an eye to exploring the sociological dimension of writing and the objective side of sociology, there's a joined-up and separate overview of the objectivity of the literary work and that of sociology. The variety of society and life is basically the raw material of literature. Because a person is a social being, both their creator and observer sides are built right out of this. You get sociology sitting right there inside whatever work the author creates. Just like a mustard seed is obvious enough, but it isn't just a mustard seed because it carries oil all through it that you only get once you crush it, this paper sets out the method or approach for digging out the sociology tucked away in literature. It gives you an introduction and a proper discussion of historical, comparative, and functional methods. When talking about the benchmarks and values of sociological study, it discusses the theoretical ground of how you can look for society, life, and psychology in a work, and then turn around and find sociology in it. A writer voices their lived experiences across all sorts of literary genres. In that sense, the era he lived through, the life he experienced, and his feelings about society's economic, social, cultural, political, and religious realities and psychology linger in his works, whether hidden or out in the open. Tracking down this exact interrelationship of society from within the work is what the sociology of literature is all about. To put it even more plainly, looking for sociology inside a literary work is the sociology of literature in a nutshell. While tracking down the sociology of literature, research and enquiry in literature look into race, era and milieu, culture, structure, linguistic sequences, world view, the structure of feeling between creator and observer, and linguistic settings. This very search and research is what makes up the sociological study of literature. For a sociological study of literature, you can fundamentally make use of historical, comparative, and functional methods. For studying literature sociologically, there are two camps backing either the reflection theory that 'literature is a mirror of society' or the critique theory that 'literature is a critique of society.' Its main movers and shakers are Madame de Staël, Hippolyte Taine, Robert Escarpit, Leo Lowenthal, Lucien Goldmann, and Raymond Williams.
